lines.content: Ski is a command-line application used to manage tasks for users.
Users can add and delete tasks to a list, and mark and unmark tasks as done.
Users are able to add 3 types of tasks:
Other features are showing the task list and finding tasks by searching keywords.
Ensure that Java 17 or above is installed in the computer.
If a directory named 'data' containing a .txt file named 'list' and a directory named
'temp' are not found in the same directory that the jar file of this application is running
in, users are given the option to either manually create the missing requirements, or allow
the program to create them. These directories and file are required by the application
to store and save users' task lists.
If choosing to manually create them, users need to restart the application after the missing
The application also creates a .txt file named 'temp' in the 'temp' directory during every
start up to use for reading and writing purposes of the users' task lists, and deletes it
in every termination of the program. Users do not have to manually create or delete this temp.txt
Parameters enclosed in square brackets e.g. `[parameter]` are to be provided by users.

| Adding todo | Format: `todo [task description]`

| Adding deadline | Format: `deadline [task description] /by [time]`
